stories.title: Orages, pluie et inondations : le Gard, l’Hérault, les Bouches-du-Rhône et le Var en vigilance orange mercredi

en.title: Storms, rain and flooding: Gard, Hérault, Bouches-du-Rhône and Var on orange alert Wednesday
en.summary: Four departments in southeastern France face severe weather conditions including thunderstorms, hail, strong winds, and potential tornadoes in coastal areas on Wednesday.

stories.title: Gratitude et nostalgie en Argentine : Lionel Messi a fait ses adieux à l'Albiceleste

en.title: Gratitude and nostalgia in Argentina: Lionel Messi bids farewell to the Albiceleste
en.summary: Lionel Messi played his final match for Argentina's national team before over 80,000 spectators in Buenos Aires, scoring one last goal and receiving an emotional sendoff from supporters.

stories.title: Christa Pike, dont la mise à mort avait échoué aux Etats-Unis, a repris connaissance et parle

en.title: Christa Pike, whose execution failed in the United States, has regained consciousness and is speaking
en.summary: Christa Pike, a death row inmate whose execution attempt failed on September 30 in Tennessee, has regained consciousness with an uncertain prognosis in what her lawyers describe as an unprecedented medical recovery.

stories.title: Le prêtre Jean-Bernard Plessy, ancien directeur des Chartreux à Lyon, mis en examen pour viol aggravé

en.title: Priest Jean-Bernard Plessy, former director of Chartreux in Lyon, placed under investigation for aggravated rape
en.summary: A priest who previously directed a Lyon institution is under investigation for aggravated rape involving a young student, with alleged abuses spanning several months through July.

stories.title: États-Unis : après son exécution ratée, Christa Pike a "repris connaissance et peut parler"

en.title: United States: after her failed execution, Christa Pike has "regained consciousness and can speak"
en.summary: Death row inmate Christa Pike has regained consciousness and is able to speak nearly a week after surviving two lethal injections in Tennessee, according to her attorneys, though they have not been permitted to visit her in the hospital.

stories.title: Christa Pike, condamnée à mort aux Etats-Unis, a repris connaissance et parle, annoncent ses avocats

en.title: Christa Pike, death row inmate in the United States, has regained consciousness and is speaking, her lawyers announce
en.summary: A woman in her fifties who was to become the first female execution in Tennessee in over 200 years survived the administration of two lethal injections last Wednesday.

stories.title: Le Renseignement allemand dans la tourmente après l'arrestation pour espionnage d'un ancien chef

en.title: German intelligence in turmoil following arrest of former chief for espionage
en.summary: August Hanning, who led German intelligence from 1998 to 2005, is suspected of using classified documents for analysis provided to a foreign intelligence service, possibly Azerbaijan, while his former chief of staff is suspected of transmitting the documents.

stories.title: Mobilisation lycéenne : entre 266 000 et 450 000 manifestants ont défilé dans toute la France

en.title: High school mobilization: between 266,000 and 450,000 protesters marched across France
en.summary: High school students, supported by student organizations and unions, protested on Tuesday. Approximately 891 secondary schools out of 3,700 experienced course suspensions, either partially or completely.

stories.title: Le gouvernement annonce la suspension des cours dans les lycées sur une demi-journée, mercredi ou jeudi, pour "un temps de démocratie"

en.title: Government announces suspension of classes in high schools for half a day, Wednesday or Thursday, for "a time of democracy"
en.summary: The Prime Minister announced a complete reorganization of school schedules to enable school leaders to organize a designated period for democratic participation.

stories.title: Fortes pluies et orages : le Gard, l’Hérault, les Bouches-du-Rhône et le Var en vigilance orange

en.title: Heavy rain and storms: Gard, Hérault, Bouches-du-Rhône and Var on orange alert
en.summary: Southern French departments are experiencing another Mediterranean weather episode with heavy rain and storms. Last week similar weather forced school closures and public transport disruptions in the region.

stories.title: Ecrits antisémites : l’affaire Jordan Bardella plombe la séquence budgétaire du RN

en.title: Antisemitic writings: the Jordan Bardella affair complicates the National Rally's budget agenda
en.summary: The National Rally leader addressed questions regarding antisemitic writings alongside Marine Le Pen at a press conference presenting the party's proposed budget trajectory for a presidential election victory.

stories.title: L'Union étudiante et l'USL appellent à une nouvelle journée d'action jeudi dans le cadre de la mobilisation des étudiants et lycéens

en.title: Student Union and USL Call for New Action Day Thursday as Part of Student and High School Student Mobilization
en.summary: Student organizations are calling for a demonstration on Thursday to demand increased human and financial resources for national education as part of their ongoing campaign.

stories.title: La France dispose d'un nouveau missile balistique clairement plus performant (M51.3)

en.title: France has a new ballistic missile clearly more powerful (M51.3)
en.summary: The French Ministry of Defence and Navy successfully conducted acceptance testing of the M51.3 strategic ballistic missile fired from the nuclear-powered submarine Le Vigilant.

stories.title: OPINION. « L’addiction n’est ni une faute morale, ni une simple affaire de volonté », par Jean-Marc Borello et Anne de Bayser, président fondateur et co-présidente du Groupe SOS

en.title: OPINION. "Addiction is Neither a Moral Fault Nor Simply a Matter of Willpower," by Jean-Marc Borello and Anne de Bayser, Founder President and Co-President of Groupe SOS
en.summary: Groupe SOS advocates for placing prevention and care at the center of public health policy, arguing that addiction should not be reduced to individual willpower or moral failure.

stories.title: Face à « la situation dramatique » des comptes publics, la recette de Marine Le Pen jugée peu crédible

en.title: Facing "dramatic situation" of public finances, Marine Le Pen's solution deemed lacking credibility
en.summary: The National Rally candidate proposes 140 billion euros in budget cuts over the next five-year term, though experts question the reliability of her cost-saving calculations at this stage.

stories.title: OPINION. « Emeutes lycéennes : pourra-t-on éteindre le volcan ? »

en.title: OPINION. "Student riots: can the volcano be extinguished?"
en.summary: Young people, particularly secondary school students, are experiencing increasingly violent unrest that raises questions about its underlying causes and predictability.

stories.title: Financement participatif immobilier : Bricks s’offre un agrément bancaire en rachetant Izola Bank

en.title: Real estate crowdfunding: Bricks acquires banking license by purchasing Izola Bank
en.summary: French fintech Bricks, which specializes in real estate crowdfunding, is acquiring Malta-based digital bank Izola Bank. The transaction requires approval from the European Central Bank and Maltese financial authorities.
